_note: PLACEHOLDER EXAMPLE — never commit a real config. Replace every <...> value with this machine's real paths and digests, then keep the filled-in file OUTSIDE the repository (beside experimentRoot or under artifacts/pd-lab/<experimentId>/). It must contain no credentials: modelEnv names environment variables only; their values are never read or logged.

preregistration.sha256: <64-hex sha256 of that file's RAW bytes, computed before declaring it>

experimentRoot: <absolute path to the run-scene root for this experiment>
additionalForbiddenRoots: <optional absolute path of another production workspace on this machine>

dataset.file: <absolute path to the full-fidelity dataset, inside experimentRoot or the archive root>

snapshot.dir: <absolute path to the snapshot dir containing state.db / trajectory.db / blob-manifest.json>

baseConfigFile: <absolute path to the copied PD config.yaml used as derivation template>

off.worktree: <absolute path to the baseline arm worktree>
off.expectedHead: <40-hex commit the baseline arm HEAD must equal>

on.worktree: <absolute path to the candidate arm worktree — MAY equal the baseline worktree for a same-commit switch experiment>
on.expectedHead: <40-hex commit the candidate arm HEAD must equal>

workspaceFiles.source: <absolute path to the file to place into the arm workspace>
